title: Ordering noodles
goal: Order a bowl of noodles and a drink, then pay.

steps.prompt_en: Say it's just you, one person.

steps.partner_en: Please sit. What would you like to eat?
steps.prompt_en: Say you want a bowl of beef noodles.
answers_en: I'd like a bowl of beef noodles.
A bowl of beef noodles, thanks.

steps.prompt_en: Ask for a cup of tea.
answers_en: I'd like a cup of tea.

steps.partner_en: Here are your noodles. Are they good?
steps.prompt_en: Say they're delicious, and ask for the bill.
answers_en: Really tasty. Let's have the bill.

title: Taking a taxi
goal: Tell the driver where to go and pay at the end.

steps.prompt_en: Say you're going to the train station.
answers_en: I'm going to the train station.

steps.partner_zh: 你的汉语很好！学了多长时间？
steps.partner_en: Your Chinese is good! How long have you studied?
steps.prompt_en: Say thank you, and that you've studied for one year.
answers_en: Thanks! I've studied for a year.

steps.prompt_en: Say here you go, and thank the driver.
answers_en: OK, here's the money. Thank you!

title: Buying fruit
goal: Buy some apples and haggle a little.

steps.prompt_en: Ask how much the apples are.
answers_en: How much are the apples per jin?
Too expensive, make it a bit cheaper.

steps.partner_zh: 好的，十六块。还要别的吗？

title: Meeting a classmate
goal: Introduce yourself to a new classmate.

steps.partner_zh: 你好！我叫小明。你叫什么名字？
steps.partner_en: Hi! I'm Xiao Ming. What's your name?
steps.prompt_en: Say hello and tell him your name.

answers_en: I really like watching football matches.

steps.partner_zh: 我也喜欢！星期六一起看吧？
steps.partner_en: Me too! Shall we watch together on Saturday?

title: At a café
goal: Order a coffee to take away.

steps.partner_en: Hi, what would you like to drink?

closing_en: Please wait a moment, it'll be right up.

title: Asking the way
goal: Find out where the metro station is.

steps.prompt_en: Ask where the metro station is.
answers_en: Excuse me, where's the metro station?

title: Buying a jacket
goal: Try on a jacket and buy it.

steps.partner_en: Welcome! What are you looking for?
steps.prompt_en: Say you want to look at that black jacket.
answers_zh: 我想看看那件黑色的衣服。
answers_en: I'd like to look at that black jacket.
I want to see that black one.

steps.partner_en: This one? You can try it on.
steps.prompt_en: Say it's a bit big, and ask for a smaller one.
answers_zh: 太大了，有小一点儿的吗？
answers_en: It's a bit big. Is there a smaller one?
Too big. Is there a smaller one?

steps.prompt_en: Say this one is good, you want it.
answers_en: This one's good, I'll take it.
Looks great! I'll take this one.

steps.prompt_en: Ask if it can be cheaper.
answers_en: Can it be a bit cheaper?

title: Football chat
goal: Chat with a friend about last night's match.

steps.partner_en: Did you watch the football yesterday?

steps.prompt_en: Say you like the red team.

steps.partner_zh: 太好了！下次我们一起看吧。
steps.partner_en: Great! Let's watch together next time.
answers_en: Sure, come and watch at mine.
